# Workflow v3 acceptance fixtures

Invented `ECON101` readings, assignment, session and guidance with retained prep,
draft and proposal candidates. Compiled-CLI replays cover source scoping,
question/checklist validation, numeric execution, completion, XLSX cell values,
versioned guidance saves and original-byte preservation. The test adapts one
retained candidate to the current detected headings; it does not rerun a model.
These fixtures do not establish academic correctness or real-course policy.
